scope: Sixth combined legal/application backfill round: Asten, Baarle-Nassau, Berg en Dal, Bergeijk and Boekel. These are targeted-research municipalities; the pass records the practical official route where established and keeps substantive/document gaps explicit.

activities.permitOrProcedureName: omgevingsvergunning where required for use/building activity
conditionalDocuments: activity/address answers in the Vergunningcheck determine permit and attachment requirements
fire-safety requirements must be assessed separately when occupancy/use triggers them

remainingLegalQuestions: ordinary room-rental rules beyond fire-safety context
remainingApplicationQuestions: representative address/activity check after substantive legal framework is consolidated

activities.permitOrProcedureName: spatial/omgevingsvergunning route depending current Omgevingsplan and proposed use
conditionalDocuments: exact documents depend on the selected activity and address
do not treat an announced/older assessment framework as current until successor/current status is positively established

remainingLegalQuestions: current assessment framework/successor policy for ordinary splitting and room rental
remainingApplicationQuestions: capture project-specific attachment output after current legal framework is established

activities.permitOrProcedureName: omgevingsvergunning or Omgevingsplan route depending use/address
conditionalDocuments: spatial compatibility and any building activity determine the application package
no municipality-specific housing attachment checklist is promoted without a current official source

remainingApplicationQuestions: representative address validation once targeted legal research is complete

activities.permitOrProcedureName: current spatial permission route; successor substantive policy still unresolved
conditionalDocuments: expired housing-stock policy is explicitly excluded as a current application basis
application requirements must be derived from the current successor/Omgevingsplan, not copied from the expired policy

remainingLegalQuestions: current successor to expired housing-stock policy
remainingApplicationQuestions: capture documents only after current substantive successor is established or via representative current Omgevingsloket result

conditionalDocuments: exact application documents are project/address dependent
generic building requirements are not treated as a housing-specific checklist

remainingApplicationQuestions: representative address/activity validation after targeted legal research

summary.qualityRule: For hard-source municipalities, establishing Omgevingsloket as the practical route does not close the substantive legal research question.
